description: Source file implementing ASN.1 helper functions for RRC messages in 5G NR, including message construction, parsing, and configuration filling.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_setup_msg
methods.description: Constructs an RRC setup message with given cell config and transaction ID.

methods.name: get_transaction_id
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID from RRC setup complete or UL DCCH message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_smc_msg
methods.description: Fills a security mode command message with specified algorithms and transaction ID.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_reconfiguration_msg
methods.description: Constructs an RRC reconfiguration message with various configuration parameters.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_resume_msg
methods.description: Constructs an RRC resume message with optional configurations.
